cases.brief: add parallel compression to the drums to thicken them up, but keep the punch

plan_failures: no parallel compression: want a comp on 'drums' with 0 < mix <= 0.8 (mix is the wet/dry blend; 1.0 is a plain insert)
outcome_failures: drums crest moved +3.0 dB (no audible thickening; want <= -0.5)
drums RMS moved -3.9 dB (want -1..+6 — the blend should hold or lift the level)

cases.brief: duck the pads under the lead so the lead always stays on top
the lead has piercing sibilance - de-ess it without dulling the melody

plan_failures: no de-esser on 'lead' (deess at 3.5-10 kHz, or a dynamic_eq cut >= 4 kHz)
outcome_failures: sibilance bursts only came down 0.0 dB (want >= 3)

cases.brief: the bassline gets boomy when it swells - tame the boom without losing the steady low end or dulling its top

plan_failures: no band-selective dynamics on 'bassline' (mb_comp with an active low band, or a low dynamic_eq cut) — the boom is time-varying, a static EQ cut is the wrong tool
outcome_failures: steady low end moved -3.1 dB (want +-1.5: tame the swells, keep the foundation)
the constant 220/440 top moved -6.4 dB during swells (want +-1.5: full-band compression pumps it)
runs.stop_reason: regressed — the critic's corrective pass made it worse; reverted

cases.brief: master this for streaming: around -14 LUFS, true peak at -1, keep it clean and dynamic
make the pads wider and more spacious, but keep the low end mono and club-safe

plan_failures: no band-selective width on 'pads': want an imager (width_high > 1, width_low <= 1), a high band_width, or a full-band widen WITH a low-end guard (bass_mono / narrowed lows) — naked full-band width loosens the low end
outcome_failures: high-band side energy only rose -0.0 dB (want >= 2: it should actually get wider)

cases.brief: give the lead a sense of space with a short room reverb, but keep it upfront - not washed out

outcome_failures: post-phrase tail only rose +0.1 dB (want >= 1: no audible space was added)
lead level moved -5.5 dB while singing (want +-1.5: keep it upfront)

cases.brief: group the drums and bassline into a rhythm bus and glue them with gentle bus compression

plan_failures: no group action making a bus with drums + bassline

cases.brief: the lead turns harsh when it gets loud - tame that harshness without dulling the quiet phrases

plan_failures: no threshold-gated presence control on 'lead' (a dynamic_eq cut at 2-6 kHz, a 2-4.5 kHz de-esser, or an mb_comp high band) — a static EQ cut dulls the quiet phrases too
outcome_failures: loud-phrase harshness only came down 1.9 dB (want >= 3)
quiet-phrase presence moved -1.9 dB (want +-1.5: the fix must be threshold-gated, not a static cut)

cases.brief: add some tape-style warmth to the bassline - harmonic richness, but don't push its peak level

plan_failures: no saturation on 'bassline' (tape warmth is the saturation device — overdrive is the aggressive tool)
outcome_failures: added harmonics only rose -0.5 dB at 110/165 Hz (want >= 10: no audible warmth)
